name: Goblin Invaders
summary: At the Barrens and Stonetalon border, Seereth Stonebreak sends the Horde to strike Venture Company loggers in Windshear Crag. Their work lays waste to the mountains' ancient woodlands.

sections.title: A Forest in Agony
sections.body: The Venture Company has cut deep into the Stonetalon Mountains, tearing through crags and valleys. Its loggers strip hillsides of timber and burn the underbrush, leaving scorched ground behind. For tauren and their allies, this is more than the destruction of forests by a mining and lumber company. The primal spirits bound to Stonetalon howl in torment. Seereth Stonebreak, stationed along the mountain border, sees that the goblins' relentless assault has left the spirits blind with agony and fury.

sections.title: The Language of Force
sections.body: The Venture Company's executives and hirelings care only for profit, and reason will not sway them. Seereth sends travelers past Greatwood Vale and into Windshear Crag to kill fifteen loggers. The Horde means to meet the company's greed with force, halting the deforestation and buying time for tauren elders to soothe the land's agitated spirits.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman stationed near the southern boundary between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She watches hostile factions encroach and works to protect the region's spiritual balance.

faq.q: Why are the goblins deforesting Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The Venture Company pursues profit without regard for the damage it causes. It treats Stonetalon's ancient forests and mineral-rich hills as materials to harvest, process, and sell, heedless of the natural and spiritual devastation left behind.

aliases: where to find venture co loggers
faq.answer: Windshear Crag lies in the central Stonetalon Mountains. From the Barrens border, follow the mountain road northwest through Greatwood Vale to the crag, where the forest gives way to Venture Company logging camps and clear-cut hills.

faq.q: How do the spirits react to the Venture Company's presence?
faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak says the land spirits suffer near-madness from rage and pain caused by the logging and burning. Their suffering disrupts nature's balance and threatens the entire region spiritually.

faq.q: What happens after culling the Venture Company loggers?
faq.answer: Killing the loggers is only the first blow against the operation. Seereth next directs the Horde against the company's machinery and recommends seeking tauren elders as guides who can help soothe the wounded spirits.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about logging in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The tauren hold the Stonetalon Mountains dear for their culture and spiritual life. The Horde also sees the Venture Company's unchecked aggression and theft of resources as threats to its influence in the region and to spiritual harmony.

angles.text: As a tauren, you have urgent cause to confront the Venture Company: its destruction of Stonetalon's forests torments the earth spirits you honor with the Earth Mother.
As a druid, you see the destruction of living groves and ancient trees in Windshear Crag as an assault on the natural order you defend.
As a shaman, you can feel the local elementals and nature spirits crying out, blinded by fury amid smoke and goblin machinery's destruction.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure the borderlands between the Barrens and the higher passes, so hostile commercial syndicates cannot fortify central Kalimdor.
